title: Desktop session bridge regression repair plan

authority.reference: Owner instruction, 2026-10-21: add the red-team findings to the plan to fix.
authority.scope: Planning, prioritization, evidence and release-gate definition only. Each code, launch, lifecycle or desktop-validation operation still needs its applicable authority.

consumer.current: Coordinator and authorized implementation/review agents reading this canonical record.
consumer.gap: No executable admission gate consumes this plan yet. A release cannot claim these controls are enforced until the relevant code, tests and release checks consume their defined requirements.

components: bridge-specific test fixtures and native acceptance evidence
scope.outcome: Prevent a launcher-created Desktop TUI from being mistaken for an arbitrary or stale session, and prevent the bridge from being released with missing lifecycle, model-admission or desktop-acceptance proof.
non_goals: Attach to an existing arbitrary Terminal or legacy mcp__codex_tui session.
Treat an alias, historical identifier, daemon-global socket or queued message as a bridge.
Claim hostile same-user-process identity protection without a host capability or OS-backed attestation.

observed: Receipt v2 binds a capability-protected loopback endpoint, exact host-created receiver, process start times, workspace, token hash and bounded expiry.
The bridge creates the receiver before launching the TUI, publishes the receipt, then sends the fixed onboarding turn; it no longer adopts a first started event.
An external supervisor retired the server and TUI after a live host SIGTERM, and focused regression coverage exercises the same host-loss path.

A held pseudo-TTY run restarted Loki and exact status authenticated its receipt-backed receiver. Computer Use is not permitted to control Terminal; visible Finder-alias observation is therefore unavailable host evidence, not a release condition.
current_state.release_claim_limit: Useful for controlled same-user coordination only. Do not claim strong host identity, existing-Desktop attachment, or native Desktop acceptance.

required_protection: Versioned receipt schema with exact workspace, receiver, process and socket correlation.
Fail-closed validation and stable error codes for malformed, stale, expired, mismatched or incomplete inputs.
Mandatory automated state, failure-matrix and lifecycle coverage.
accidental_cross_agent_mistake.release_target: Required for any supported bridge release.

hostile_same_user_process.current_protection: Private paths, permissions, hashes and command fragments are insufficient because another same-user process can imitate them.
hostile_same_user_process.required_for_claim: A host-issued unforgeable capability or OS-backed attestation that binds the launcher, TUI, receiver, workspace and process lifetime.
hostile_same_user_process.release_target: Out of scope until that host facility exists and is independently qualified.

findings.title: Receipt lacks authenticated host identity and PID-reuse protection
findings.risk: A same-user process can imitate receipt paths or command fragments; an old PID can be reused.
findings.required_result: For the accidental-mistake scope, bind every checked process to a lifetime identity as well as PID and require one correlated host-issued bridge capability before status. Do not represent this as hostile-process protection.

findings.title: TUI-to-receiver ownership is inferred from the first started event
findings.risk: A different thread using the private broker can satisfy workspace-only correlation.
findings.required_result: Correlate the launched TUI, broker connection and receiver through a launch nonce or host-issued identity; reject unrelated or first-arrival events.

findings.title: Abrupt host death can orphan the broker
findings.risk: SIGTERM or crash can bypass normal cleanup and leave a route or alias occupied.
findings.required_result: Use a supervised ownership/liveness relationship and prove normal exit, SIGTERM and abrupt-host-loss cleanup or deterministic stale-resource retirement. SIGKILL may only be verified by external supervision because a killed process cannot clean itself.

findings.title: Visible Desktop observation is unavailable on this host
observed_in: Current Computer Use and LaunchServices presentation route
findings.risk: PTY proof does not establish visible Finder alias presentation.
findings.required_result: Treat visible Finder-alias observation as optional host evidence. Release acceptance uses the supported launcher route, completed onboarding and receipt-backed exact status; an unavailable Apple presenter cannot block it.

findings.title: Model admission is manual
findings.risk: Onboarding can be sent to an unavailable model.
findings.required_result: Check live model/list availability for the selected model before any onboarding prompt is sent.

findings.title: Receipt publication follows onboarding start
findings.risk: The TUI can receive work before the corresponding identity receipt exists.
findings.required_result: Define and test either a bounded pre-receipt onboarding phase with no ordinary work or a two-phase startup where receipt publication precedes onboarding.

findings.title: Bridge runtime dependency identity is not verified at launch
findings.risk: Presence of a Python executable does not establish the expected websockets package or bytes.
findings.required_result: Validate the pinned bridge interpreter and dependency manifest before launch; fail closed on mismatch.

findings.title: Bridge-specific regression fixtures are missing
findings.risk: Legacy-binding rejection does not exercise the bridge's identity, lifecycle or launch-order failures.
findings.required_result: Add fixtures for forged, stale and expired receipts; PID lifetime mismatch; wrong TUI route; wrong first started event; orphan broker; unavailable model; and socket failure cases.

findings.title: Clock and private socket-path edge cases are underspecified
findings.risk: Wall-clock changes, stale sockets, collisions and symlinks can undermine otherwise correct checks.
findings.required_result: Specify monotonic-versus-wall-clock use, expiry skew behavior, directory ownership/mode, collision handling, O_NOFOLLOW-style validation where available, stale-socket retirement and cleanup evidence.

work_items.title: Make bridge admission and claim boundaries executable
acceptance: One versioned receipt schema names every identity, lifetime, expiry and authority field and rejects unknown or incomplete variants at the consumer boundary.
Documentation states the bounded pre-receipt phase, if retained, and explicitly forbids ordinary work in it.
Release reporting separates accidental-mistake protection from hostile same-user-process protection.

work_items.title: Bind receipt to a process lifetime and issuer
work_items.blocker: A strong hostile-process claim requires host-issued capability or OS-backed attestation that the current bridge does not expose.
acceptance: The accidental-mistake path rejects stale or PID-reused processes using an observed lifetime identity in addition to PID.
The receipt issuer and consumer perform a correlated, fail-closed capability check.
Claims remain limited to the protection actually established.

work_items.title: Correlate launched TUI to exact receiver
acceptance: The event that establishes the receiver carries a launch-specific correlation value unavailable to unrelated first arrivals.
Wrong workspace, wrong launch value, duplicate start and wrong-first-event fixtures each fail closed with stable codes.

work_items.title: Supervise broker lifecycle and alias release
acceptance: Normal TUI exit, SIGTERM and host crash each leave no usable orphan broker or alias lease.
Where in-process cleanup cannot run, an external supervisor detects and retires stale resources without attaching to an unrelated session.
Lifecycle evidence records the observed owner and resource retirement.

work_items.title: Admit the selected model before onboarding
acceptance: A live model/list response contains the pinned selected model before any onboarding delivery.
Unavailable, malformed or inconclusive model data fails closed and sends no onboarding.

work_items.title: Verify bridge runtime bytes before launch
acceptance: Launcher validation proves the expected interpreter, bridge module and pinned dependency identity before spawning the bridge.
Missing or mismatched bytes fail before TUI or onboarding start.

work_items.title: Add state-machine and failure-matrix fixtures
acceptance: A passing state-machine test covers broker start, TUI start, matching receiver observation, receipt publication and exact status.
Every listed malformed, stale, expired, PID-lifetime, route, receiver, model and socket failure fails closed with its documented stable code.
No fixture substitutes a queue, terminal input, alias or legacy session identifier.

work_items.title: Specify and test time and private-socket handling
acceptance: Expiry behavior is deterministic across clock changes and skew within the stated support boundary.
Socket directory collision, symlink, stale path and cleanup fixtures preserve private ownership and fail closed.

work_items.title: Optional visible Desktop observation
work_items.blocker: Computer Use is not permitted to control Terminal on this host.
acceptance: Finder alias visibly launches the intended Terminal/TUI.
The intended onboarding completes through that visible path.
A current receipt-backed exact status reads the matching receiver after onboarding.
If the presenter is unavailable, retain that limitation without changing bridge release status.

release_gates.name: Bridge state machine
release_gates.pass_condition: broker starts -> TUI starts -> matching receiver observed -> receipt written -> exact status passes

release_gates.name: Fail-closed failure matrix
release_gates.pass_condition: Every invalid receipt, process, socket, receiver and model condition rejects with a stable documented code.

release_gates.name: Lifecycle retirement
release_gates.pass_condition: Normal exit, SIGTERM and abrupt-host-loss scenarios retire the broker and release the alias without crossing into another session.

release_gates.name: Model admission
release_gates.pass_condition: The live model list contains the selected model before onboarding begins.

release_gates.name: Visible Desktop observation
release_gates.pass_condition: When the host permits it, visible Finder-alias launch is recorded alongside the normal supported-route acceptance. Its absence does not block release.

source_observations: Launcher/desktop_bridge.py receiver creation, capability route, lifecycle supervision and receipt ordering
evidence.runtime_observation_limit: Launcher/build/loki-repaired-status-20261021-final contains exact receipt-backed Loki status. The held pseudo-TTY is controlled-route evidence only; visible Finder-alias observation was unavailable on this host and is optional evidence.

next_eligible_action.action: No release action remains. Record visible Finder-alias observation only on a host where Terminal presentation is supported.
